{{Top}}
{{Citation}}
[[File:Montra_Varn_AoRSR.png|thumb|180px|Lieutenant [[Montra Varn]] of the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|ISB]]]]

'''Lieutenant''' was a [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] widely used in military, paramilitary or [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police organizations]],<ref name="Senate Murders">{{TCW|Senate Murders}}</ref> normally borne by low-ranking commissioned officers. It was higher than a [[Second Lieutenant/Legends|second lieutenant]] and lower than a [[Captain/Legends|captain]].

In space fleets, most lieutenants were found in command of small vessels, as senior officers aboard medium-sized vessels and as junior and mid-ranking command personnel on large [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]].

Surface forces often saw lieutenants holding the lowest level of field commands (such as [[Platoon/Legends|platoons]] in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]]), as aides to more senior officers, or as vehicle operators. Sometimes, clone lieutenants were given command of fleets and ground forces. One such person was [[Clone Lieutenant/Legends|clone trooper Lieutenant]] [[Trapper (clone trooper)/Legends|Trapper]], who led a platoon of men at the [[Battle of Malastare/Legends|Battle of Malastare]].
[[File:Snowtrooper_Lieutenant.jpg|thumb|left|200px|An [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Cold assault stormtrooper|snowtrooper]] lieutenant]]
Starfighter forces placed lieutenants as junior officers, rarely any higher in the command hierarchy than lead of a wing-pair. Even a flight of three or four fighters was rarely led by a lieutenant, although exceptions were made when there was a general lack of senior or experienced officers. In the months before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Hamo Blastwell]] even commanded [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]] as a lieutenant.

This rank was in use in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Sith Wars/Legends|Sith Wars]].<ref name="SWTORE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

Within the Empire, the rank of lieutenant had two different insignias, each representing a different rank. The rank of First Lieutenant was represented by four blue squares and two code cylinders. In addition, the rank of lieutenant or higher was required to man the [[Command sector duty post]]s onboard the Death Stars, as well as given the task of supervising the command sectors.<ref name="DSOTM">''[[Death Star Owner's Technical Manual]]''</ref> The rank of second lieutenant was represented by a plaque of two red squares above two blue squares, and one code cylinder that was in effect until the reorganization had been concluded. Fleet Admiral Holt implied during his indoctrination speech at the Imperial Naval Academy that the rank of lieutenant is earned by spending 30 months of rigorous physical and academic training at the academy.

Somewhat confusingly, in the starfighter forces of both the Imperial military and the New Republic, the title "lieutenant" could be used to address not only flight lieutenants, but also the more junior [[Flight officer/Legends|flight officers]].

In the Rebel Alliance's starfighter corps pre-[[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] the rank of lieutenant stood between [[Flight officer/Legends|flight officer]] and captain and was identifiable via a silver patch on the left shoulder with two yellow bumps, one on the top-center and the bottom-center, respectively.<ref name="X-wing">[[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']]</ref> Post-Battle of Hoth, it ranked between [[Junior Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant Junior Grade]] (a then-recent addition) and captain, and the insignia was subsequently changed to a patch with a gold trim-border and a red dot in the center, though as before it was placed on the left shoulder of the uniform.<ref name="Alliance">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]''</ref> The rank of captain during the latter time period did, however, possess a similar rank insignia to that of lieutenant.<ref name="X-wing" />
